Title: Архивъ Юго-Западной Россіи, часть I, томъ IX: Лиѳосъ, полемическое сочиненіе, вышедшее изъ Кіево-Печерской типографіи въ 1644 году, съ собственноручными замѣчаніями къ нему Кассіана Саковича (Archive of South-Western Russia, part 1, vol. 9: Lithos, the polemical work printed at the Kyiv Caves press in 1644, with Kassian Sakovych's own marginal notes), with an introductory study
Creator: Lithos albo kamien (1644), published under the pseudonym Euzebi Pimin, which the edition's index calls the pseudonym of the compilers of the Lithos (file line 25541), from the circle of Peter Mohyla; with the marginal notes of Kassian Sakovych; introductory study signed S. Golubev (Kyiv, 15 November 1893, file line 5985-5986); published by the Kyiv Commission for the Examination of Ancient Acts
Publisher: Kyiv: Typography of G. T. Korchak-Novitsky, for the Temporary Commission for the Examination of Ancient Acts
Publication Date: 1893 (the OCR of the title page reads '1393'; Golubev's signature is dated 15 November 1893 and the host record gives 1893)
Rights: Public Domain (published 1893, more than 95 years before 2026; the Internet Archive item carries no rights field)
Language: pol
Source: Internet Archive item arhivjugozapadnojrossiiizdavaemyjvreme37, file arhivjugozapadnojrossiiizdavaemyjvreme37_djvu.txt, fetched directly (curl, raw bytes) by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session, second pass, VI.21 world agent), 2026-10-23; host rights statement: the item carries no possible-copyright-status or licence field (community upload from the Presidential Library series of Russian online libraries); the rights basis is the 1893 imprint, read as '1393' in the OCR of the title page (file line 31) and confirmed by the dated signature of the introduction (file line 5985)
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged (no characters altered, nothing retyped, dropped or corrected; the file contains 0 long-s glyphs; the OCR's doubled spaces between words are left as scanned). Rights basis restated: a book printed at Kyiv in 1893 is public domain in the United States by date under the 95-year rule. File line numbers cited in this header are counted in the OCR text alone, before this header: add 10 to find a cited line in this file.
Content note: Language tag 'pol': the Lithos itself is Polish (with Latin and Church Slavonic quotations); Golubev's introductory study (from about file line 60 to file line 5986, with a Russian summary of Sakovych's Perspektiwa points, for example at file line 2569 region) is Russian. The Lithos text begins at about file line 5990 (the OCR reads its title as 'лиеосъ'). The Lithos is the Kyiv-Pechersk answer of 1644 to Kassian Sakovych's Epanorthosis abo perspektiwa (Krakow 1642) and defends the liturgical and sacramental practice of the Orthodox Ruthenian church under Mohyla, section by section. OCR sampled at five points: Golubev's Russian is readable; the Polish text of the Lithos is garbled throughout, the OCR having read the Latin type as Cyrillic look-alike letters (for example 'Роёу ога Кг2зба' for Polish words), so the Lithos itself is a second witness only, vendored because no other copy of this text is in the corpus and the Kyiv dossier named it as a gap. Nothing here is quotable without the page images; a mechanical mapping of the substitution pattern, verified against page images, would be the lead's call.
